During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''enhanced TIE blaster cannon prototype''' was tested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Intended for use on [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the prototype was field tested by elite [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]. The [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] had improved targeting software, resulting in greater range and power for the weapon but at the cost of requiring more powerful [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]].<ref name="CCG-Boosted" />
